evidence.quote: 〔苗族芦笙〕由笙斗、笙管、簧片和共鸣管构成。笙斗又称气箱，多用杉木、松木或梧桐木制作...笙管多用白竹制作

fact.statement: 传统芦笙由笙斗、笙管、簧片和共鸣管构成，笙斗多用杉木、松木或梧桐木制作，笙管多用白竹制作。

conditions: 苗族宗教/万物有灵信仰
春季开始到秋季收获期间

evidence.quote: In the Miao religion, they believe lusheng is a spiritual instrument (an animism belief) and has a certain effect on the gods. Between the beginning of spring and autumn harvest, lusheng playing is prohibited.

fact.statement: 在苗族宗教观念中，芦笙被视为具有灵性的乐器，在春季开始到秋季收获期间禁止吹奏，否则被认为会冒犯神灵。

conditions: 基于百度百科词条S8535dbd47b17的描述

evidence.quote: 芦笙，为西南地区苗、瑶、侗等民族的簧管乐器。 发源于中原，后来在少数民族地区发扬光大，其前身为竽。

exceptions: 其他来源（如Sc651776c6a32）提出不同起源观点，见unresolved_conflicts
fact.statement: 根据百度百科词条，芦笙是西南地区苗、瑶、侗等民族的簧管乐器，发源于中原，前身为竽。

conditions: 特指“整套苗族六管芦笙”这一集合，而非单支芦笙

evidence.quote: 整套苗族六管芦笙，从倍低音到最高音共有大小五种规格，音列按五声音阶排列，发音每种规格为一个八度，音域A1—a3，共有五个八度。

facts.statement: 整套苗族六管芦笙从倍低音到最高音共有大小五种规格，音列按五声音阶排列，每种规格发音为一个八度，总音域为A1—a3，共五个八度。

conditions: 特指“苗族芦笙制作技艺”

evidence.quote: On May 20, 2006, the production techniques on lusheng of the Miao nationality group was approved by China State Council and listed in the State-Level Non-Material Cultural Heritage List.

facts.statement: 2006年5月20日，苗族芦笙制作技艺被中国国务院批准列入国家级非物质文化遗产名录。

conditions: 基于维基百科描述的苗族（Hmong）传统习俗

evidence.quote: When a Miao man picks his mate, he will play lusheng songs like "asking for a flower belt" and ask for a love token from the woman.

evidence.quote: The physical universe has been defined as "The totality of all space and time; all that is, has been, and will be."

facts.statement: 物理宇宙被定义为“所有时空的总和；所有存在、曾经存在和将要存在的事物”。

conditions: 针对英语单词 universe 的词源

evidence.quote: The word universe derives from the Old French word univers, which in turn derives from the Latin word universus, meaning 'combined into one'.

facts.statement: 英语单词 universe 源自古法语单词 univers，后者又源自拉丁语单词 universus，意为“结合为一”。

evidence.quote: The prevailing model for the evolution of the universe is the Big Bang theory.
In the Big Bang model, the earliest state of the universe was extremely hot and dense but the universe cooled during subsequent expansion.

facts.statement: 宇宙演化的主流模型是大爆炸理论；在该模型中，宇宙最早的状态极其炎热和致密，随后在膨胀过程中冷却。

conditions: 假设 Lambda-CDM 模型正确

evidence.quote: Assuming that the Lambda-CDM model is correct, the measurements of the parameters using a variety of techniques by numerous experiments yield a best value of the age of the universe at 13.799 ± 0.021 billion years, as of 2015.

facts.statement: 假设 Lambda-CDM 模型正确，截至 2015 年，多种技术测量得出的宇宙年龄最佳值为 13.799 ± 0.021 billion years。

conditions: 基于光速有限这一物理事实

evidence.quote: Due to the finite speed of light, there is a limit (known as the particle horizon) to how far light can travel over the age of the universe.

facts.statement: 由于光速有限，光在宇宙年龄期间能传播的距离存在极限，这一极限被称为粒子视界（particle horizon）。
